function tone(freq=440,duration=.08,type="sine",gain=.035){
 if(!soundOn)return;
 try{
   audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
   const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();
   o.type=type;o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.value=gain;
   o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();
   g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+duration);
   o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+duration);
 }catch(e){}
}

function migrateSavedState(s,version){
 const n=s.players?.length||2;
 const newStart=bankForPlayers(n);

 if(!s.bankStart || version<20){
   const oldStart=s.bankStart||780;
   const ratio=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,s.bank/Math.max(1,oldStart)));
   s.bankStart=newStart;
   s.bank=Math.round(newStart*ratio);
 }else{
   s.bankStart=newStart;
 }

 const normalizeList=list=>(list||[]).map(normalizeCard);

 (s.players||[]).forEach(p=>{

}

  const snap=JSON.parse(raw);if(!snap?.state?.players?.length)return false;
  const s=migrateSavedState(snap.state,snap.version||0);
  s.newsDeck=buildNewsFromHeadlines(s.newsDeck);
  s.newsDiscard=buildNewsFromHeadlines(s.newsDiscard);
  state=s;
  if(!state.players[state.current]?.stats)return false;
  q("lobby").classList.add("hidden");q("game").classList.remove("hidden");
  q("log").innerHTML="";
  log(`💾 Gespeichertes Spiel auf V2.0 migriert · Runde ${Math.floor((state.turnNumber-1)/state.players.length)+1}.`);
  if(state.finalRound)log(`🏁 <b>Schlussrunde läuft.</b> Nach Abschluss dieser Runde endet das Spiel.`);
  setLeftTab("score");render();return true;
 }catch(e){return false}
}
function updateContinueButton(){
 const b=q("continueBtn");if(!b)return;b.classList.toggle("hidden",!hasSavedGame());
}
function money(n){return `${Math.max(0,n)} Z`}
function branchObj(id){return branches.find(b=>b.id===id)}
function uid(){return (crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Date.now())}
function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function log(msg){const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="log-line";d.innerHTML=msg;q("log").prepend(d)}
function modal(title,html,mode=""){

 m.classList.remove("hidden");
}

 el.style.left=(window.innerWidth*.5-50+Math.random()*100)+"px";
 el.style.top=(window.innerHeight*.53+Math.random()*30)+"px";
 el.style.color=positive?"#ffe179":"#ff7f86";
 document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),1250);
}

function dieHTML(face){
 const pips = face===1?['p5']
              : face===2?['p1','p9']
              : face===3?['p1','p5','p9']
              : face===4?['p1','p3','p7','p9']
              : face===5?['p1','p3','p5','p7','p9']
              : ['p1','p3','p4','p6','p7','p9'];
 return `<div class="rule-die f${face}">${pips.map(p=>`<span class="pip ${p}"></span>`).join('')}</div>`;
}
function playDieHTML(face){
 const map={
  1:["p5"],2:["p1","p9"],3:["p1","p5","p9"],4:["p1","p3","p7","p9"],
  5:["p1","p3","p5","p7","p9"],6:["p1","p3","p4","p6","p7","p9"]
 };
 return `<div class="play-die-face">${map[face].map(p=>`<span class="play-pip ${p}"></span>`).join("")}</div>`;
}
function renderPayoutOverlay(){
 const box=q("scoreDock");
 if(!box)return;
 const currentName=(state.rolls>0&&state.phase==="roll")?evaluate(state.dice).name:null;
 box.innerHTML = `<div class="payout-head"><div>Würfelergebnis</div><div>Auszahlung</div></div>` +
   payoutRows.map(row=>`
      <div class="payout-row ${currentName===row.name?"score-current":""}">
        <div class="payout-left">
          <div class="dice-strip">${row.dice.map(d=>dieHTML(d)).join("")}</div>
          <div class="payout-name">${row.name}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="payout-value">${row.value} Z</div>
      </div>
   `).join("");
}

function createDeck(){
 const deck=[];
 const tiers=[
   {cost:5,value:6,tier:"Basis",risk:"niedrig"},
   {cost:10,value:12,tier:"Solide",risk:"mittel"},
   {cost:15,value:18,tier:"Wachstum",risk:"mittel"},
   {cost:20,value:25,tier:"Premium",risk:"hoch"}
 ];
 branches.forEach(b=>{
   tiers.forEach((t,i)=>{
     deck.push({id:uid(),type:"Aktie",branch:b.id,value:t.value,cost:t.cost,corp:corpNames[b.id][i],tier:t.tier,risk:t.risk});
   });
   [{cost:30,value:50},{cost:50,value:80}].forEach((t,i)=>{
     deck.push({id:uid(),type:"Aktienurkunde",branch:b.id,value:t.value,cost:t.cost,corp:certNames[b.id][i],tier:"Urkunde",risk:"Einmal-Chance"});
   });
 });
 return shuffle(deck);
}
function startupFor(i){
 const b=branches[i%branches.length];
 return {id:"startup-"+i,type:"Start-up",branch:b.id,value:5,cost:0,corp:"Start-up"};
}
function createNewsDeck(){
 const sectorNews=branches.map(b=>({
   title:`Krise bei ${b.name}`,
   headline:`Schlechter Tag für ${b.name}!`,
   icon:b.icon,tone:"bad",severity:"BRANCHENKRISE",
   effect:`Gekaufte ${b.name}-Investments werden teuer: 10 Z für die erste Karte, danach +5 Z je weitere Karte (max. 25 Z). Start-ups sind geschützt.`,
   run(){
     state.players.forEach(p=>{
       const n=p.cards.filter(c=>c.branch===b.id&&c.type!=="Start-up").length;
       if(n>0)charge(p,Math.min(25,10+(n-1)*5),`${b.name}-Krise`);
     });
   }
 }));
 const extra=[
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Teure Marktaufsicht greift durch!",icon:"🏛️",tone:"warn",severity:"GEBÜHREN",
   effect:"Jeder zahlt 5 Z je gekauftem Wertpapier, maximal 25 Z. Start-ups bleiben kostenlos.",
   run(){state.players.forEach(p=>charge(p,Math.min(25,p.cards.filter(c=>c.type!=="Start-up").length*5),"Marktaufsicht"))}
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Zertifikate unter Beschuss!",icon:"📜",tone:"bad",severity:"URKUNDENRISIKO",
   effect:"Für jede gehaltene Aktienurkunde werden 10 Z fällig, maximal 20 Z.",
   run(){state.players.forEach(p=>charge(p,Math.min(20,p.cards.filter(c=>c.type==="Aktienurkunde").length*10),"Urkundenprüfung"))}
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Fehlinvestition!",icon:"📉",tone:"bad",severity:"PANIKVERKAUF",
   effect:"Jeder Spieler verliert seine günstigste normale Aktie. Start-ups und Aktienurkunden sind geschützt.",
   run(){
     state.players.forEach(p=>{
       const normal=p.cards.filter(c=>c.type==="Aktie").sort((a,b)=>a.cost-b.cost);
       if(normal.length){const doomed=normal[0];discardOne(p,c=>c.id===doomed.id,"Fehlinvestition")}
     });
   }
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Börsenbeben!",icon:"🌪️",tone:"bad",severity:"MARKTSCHOCK",
   effect:"Alle Spieler zahlen 10 Z an die Bank.",
   run(){state.players.forEach(p=>charge(p,10,"Börsenbeben"))}
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Depotgebühren explodieren!",icon:"🧾",tone:"warn",severity:"DEPOTKOSTEN",
   effect:"Jeder zahlt 3 Z je gekauftem Wertpapier, maximal 18 Z.",
   run(){state.players.forEach(p=>charge(p,Math.min(18,p.cards.filter(c=>c.type!=="Start-up").length*3),"Depotgebühren"))}
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Konjunkturpaket!",icon:"📈",tone:"good",severity:"AUFSCHWUNG",
   effect:"Die Bank schüttet an jeden Spieler 5 Z aus.",
   run(){state.players.forEach(p=>{if(state.bank>0)payFromBank(p,5,"aus dem Konjunkturpaket","other")})}
  },
  {
   title:"Börsennews",headline:"Rettungspaket für kleine Vermögen!",icon:"🛟",tone:"good",severity:"RETTUNGSPAKET",
   effect:"Der aktuell bargeldärmste Spieler erhält 15 Z aus der Bank. Bei Gleichstand erhalten alle Betroffenen je 10 Z.",
   run(){
     const low=Math.min(...state.players.map(p=>p.cash));
     const poor=state.players.filter(p=>p.cash===low);
     const amount=poor.length>1?10:15;
     poor.forEach(p=>{if(state.bank>0)payFromBank(p,amount,"aus dem Rettungspaket","other")});
   }
  }
 ];
 return shuffle([...sectorNews,...extra]);
}
function discardOne(p,predicate,label){
 const candidates=p.cards.map((c,i)=>({c,i})).filter(x=>predicate(x.c));
 if(!candidates.length)return;
 const pick=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
 const [card]=p.cards.splice(pick.i,1);state.discard.push(card);
 log(`🗑️ ${p.name} verliert ${label}: <b>${card.corp}</b>.`);
}
function drawMarket(){while(state.market.length<4 && state.deck.length) state.market.push(state.deck.pop())}
function drawNews(){if(!state.newsDeck.length){state.newsDeck=shuffle([...state.newsDiscard]);state.newsDiscard=[];log("📰 Der Börsennews-Stapel wurde neu gemischt.")}return state.newsDeck.pop()}

q("startBtn").onclick=()=>{
 clearSavedGame();
 state.players=[];
 for(let i=0;i<state.playerCount;i++){
   const name=q("name"+i).value.trim()||`Spieler ${i+1}`;
   state.players.push({
     name,cash:0,cards:[startupFor(i)],color:playerColors[i],
     stats:{diceIncome:0,branchIncome:0,spent:0,newsLoss:0,purchases:0,bestResult:"–",bestValue:0,turns:0}
   });
 }

 const starter=Math.floor(Math.random()*state.players.length);
 state.current=starter;
 state.viewedPlayer=starter;
 state.roundAnchor=starter;
 state.turnNumber=1;
 state.finalRound=false;
 state.lastBankStage="calm";
 state.bankStart=bankForPlayers(state.players.length);
 state.bank=state.bankStart;

 state.players.forEach((p,i)=>p.stats.turns=0);
 state.players[starter].stats.turns=1;

 const compensation=[];
 for(let pos=1;pos<state.players.length;pos++){
   const idx=(starter+pos)%state.players.length;
   const bonus=startCompensation(pos);
   state.players[idx].cash+=bonus;
   state.bank-=bonus;
   compensation.push(`${state.players[idx].name} +${bonus} Z`);
 }

 state.deck=createDeck();state.market=[];state.discard=[];
 state.newsDeck=createNewsDeck();state.newsDiscard=[];drawMarket();
 resetTurnState();

 q("lobby").classList.add("hidden");q("game").classList.remove("hidden");q("log").innerHTML="";
 log(`🎲 Startspieler ausgelost: <b>${state.players[starter].name}</b>.`);
 log(`🏦 Bank für ${state.players.length} Spieler: <b>${state.bankStart} Z</b>.`);
 if(compensation.length)log(`⚖️ Startausgleich: ${compensation.join(" · ")}.`);
 log(`🃏 Marktdeck: 20 Aktien + 10 Aktienurkunden · 📰 12 Börsennews.`);
 setLeftTab("score");
 render();
};

 state.dice=[1,1,1,1,1];
 state.held=[false,false,false,false,false];
 state.branchRoll=null;
 state.rolls=0;
 state.phase="roll";
 state.bought=false;
 state.branchResolved=false;
 state.locked=false;
 state.selectedMarket=null;
}

function finalThreshold(){
 return Math.max(1,Math.ceil((state.bankStart||bankForPlayers(state.players.length))*0.10));
}
function bankStageKey(){
 const start=state.bankStart||bankForPlayers(state.players.length);
 const ratio=state.bank/Math.max(1,start);
 if(state.finalRound||ratio<=.10)return "final";
 if(ratio<=.25)return "hot";
 if(ratio<=.50)return "active";
 return "calm";
}
function bankStageLabel(stage){
 return state.finalRound?"🏁 SCHLUSSRUNDE":stage==="final"?"🚨 FINALE":stage==="hot"?"🔥 Heiße Phase":stage==="active"?"📊 Bewegter Markt":"● Ruhiger Markt";
}
function showStageToast(stage){
 if(state.finalRound)return;
 const old=document.querySelector(".market-stage-toast");if(old)old.remove();
 const el=document.createElement("div");el.className=`market-stage-toast ${stage}`;
 el.innerHTML=stage==="final"?"🚨 <b>Finale naht!</b> Die Bank nähert sich der Schlussrunde.":stage==="hot"?"🔥 <b>Heiße Phase!</b> Das Spiel nähert sich dem Ende.":"📊 Der Markt wird spürbar aktiver.";
 document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),2200);
}
function renderMarketStage(){
 const stage=bankStageKey();
 document.body.dataset.marketStage=stage;
 const mood=q("marketMood"),txt=q("marketMoodText");
 if(mood){mood.className=`market-mood ${stage}`;txt.textContent=bankStageLabel(stage)}
 const rank={calm:0,active:1,hot:2,final:3};
 if(!state.lastBankStage)state.lastBankStage=stage;
 if(rank[stage]>rank[state.lastBankStage])showStageToast(stage);
 state.lastBankStage=stage;
}

 if(!state.players.length)return;
 q("turnPill").textContent=`Am Zug: ${state.players[state.current].name}`;
 q("bankDisplay").textContent=`🏦 Bank: ${money(state.bank)}`;
 q("roundDisplay").textContent=`Runde ${Math.floor((state.turnNumber-1)/state.players.length)+1} · Zug ${state.turnNumber}${state.finalRound?" · SCHLUSSRUNDE":""}`;
 q("roundDisplay").classList.toggle("final-round",state.finalRound);
 const bankPct=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(state.bank/Math.max(1,state.bankStart||bankForPlayers(state.players.length)))*100));
 q("bankMeterFill").style.width=bankPct+"%";
 const bankWrap=q("bankDisplay").closest(".bank-wrap");
 const bankRatio=state.bank/Math.max(1,state.bankStart||bankForPlayers(state.players.length));
 bankWrap.classList.toggle("low-bank",bankRatio<=.25&&bankRatio>.10);
 bankWrap.classList.toggle("critical-bank",bankRatio<=.10||state.finalRound);
 renderMarketStage();
 q("deckDisplay").textContent=`🃏 ${state.deck.length} + ${state.market.length}`;
 q("deckDisplay").title=`Aktienstapel: ${state.deck.length} · offen im Markt: ${state.market.length}`;
 q("newsDisplay").textContent=`📰 ${state.newsDeck.length}`;
 q("phaseLabel").textContent="Phase: "+(state.phase==="roll"?"Würfeln":state.phase==="invest"?"Investieren":"–");
 renderPayoutOverlay(); renderPlayers(); renderMarket(); renderDepot(); renderDice(); renderBranchLegend(); renderControls();
 saveGame(false);
}

function renderPlayers(){
 const box=q("players");box.innerHTML="";
 state.players.forEach((p,i)=>{
   const counts={};branches.forEach(b=>counts[b.id]=p.cards.filter(c=>c.branch===b.id).length);
   const certs=p.cards.filter(c=>c.type==="Aktienurkunde").length;
   const holdings=branches.filter(b=>counts[b.id]).map(b=>`${b.icon} ${counts[b.id]}`).join(" · ");
   const d=document.createElement("div");
   d.className="player-card"+(i===state.current?" active":"")+(i===state.viewedPlayer?" viewed":"");
   d.style.setProperty("--pc",p.color);
   d.innerHTML=`<div class="pname">${i===state.current?"▶ ":""}${p.name}</div>
                <div class="money">💰 ${money(p.cash)}</div>
                <div class="holdings">${holdings||"Keine Beteiligungen"}${certs?`<br>📜 ${certs} Aktienurkunde${certs>1?"n":""}`:""}</div>
                <div class="player-statline">🎲 ${p.stats.diceIncome} Z · 🏢 ${p.stats.branchIncome} Z · 🛒 ${p.stats.purchases}</div>`;
   d.onclick=()=>{state.viewedPlayer=i;renderPlayers();renderDepot();};
   box.appendChild(d);
 });
}

function sortCards(cards){
 const typeRank = {"Start-up":0,"Aktie":1,"Aktienurkunde":2};
 return [...cards].sort((a,b)=>{
   const bo = branchOrder.indexOf(a.branch) - branchOrder.indexOf(b.branch);
   if(bo!==0)return bo;
   const to = (typeRank[a.type]??9) - (typeRank[b.type]??9);
   if(to!==0)return to;
   return a.cost - b.cost || a.value - b.value || a.corp.localeCompare(b.corp);
 });
}

function buildPrettyCard(card, mini=false){

 const startup=card.type==="Start-up";

 const desc=companyDescriptions[card.corp] || "";
 if(startup){
   return `
   <div class="card-shell startup-card" style="--c1:${b.c1};--c2:${b.c2}">
     <button class="card-info" onclick="event.stopPropagation();showCardInfoById('${card.id}')">i</button>
     <div class="real-card-photo startup-photo" style="background-image:url('${art}')">
       <div class="real-card-branch">${b.icon} ${b.name}</div>
     </div>
     <div class="real-card-body">
       <div class="real-card-company">${card.corp}</div>
       <div class="real-card-desc">Dein Start-up</div>
       <div class="real-card-bottom"><span>Grundwert</span><b>${card.value} Z</b></div>
     </div>
   </div>`;
 }
 return `
   <div class="card-shell realistic-market-card ${cert?"certificate":""}" style="--c1:${b.c1};--c2:${b.c2}">
     ${cert?`<div class="certificate-seal">URKUNDE</div>`:""}
     <button class="card-info" onclick="event.stopPropagation();showCardInfoById('${card.id}')">i</button>
     <div class="real-card-photo" style="background-image:url('${art}')">
       <div class="real-card-branch">${b.icon} ${b.name}</div>
       <div class="real-card-price">${card.cost} Z</div>
     </div>
     <div class="real-card-body">
       <div class="real-card-company">${card.corp}</div>
       <div class="real-card-desc">${desc}</div>
       <div class="real-card-bottom">
         <span>${cert?"Einmalauszahlung":"Ertrag"}</span>
         <b>${card.value} Z</b>
       </div>
     </div>
   </div>`;
}




function findCardById(id){
 for(const c of state.market)if(c.id===id)return c;
 for(const p of state.players)for(const c of p.cards)if(c.id===id)return c;
 for(const c of state.discard)if(c.id===id)return c;
 return null;
}
function investmentProfile(card){
 if(card.type==="Start-up")return {label:"Start-up",text:"kostenloser Grundwert"};
 if(card.type==="Aktienurkunde")return {label:"Einmal-Chance",text:`${card.cost} Z Einsatz → ${card.value} Z einmalig`};
 const ratio=card.value/card.cost;
 const label=card.tier|| (ratio>=1.3?"Wachstum":ratio>=1.15?"Solide":"Basis");
 return {label,text:`${card.cost} Z Einsatz → ${card.value} Z je Treffer`};
}
function showCardInfoById(id){
 const card=findCardById(id);if(!card)return;
 const b=branchObj(card.branch),cert=card.type==="Aktienurkunde";
 const income=cert?`${card.value} Z einmalig bei ${b.name}`:`${card.value} Z bei ${b.name}`;
 const body=`
  <div class="card-detail">
   <div class="card-detail-preview" style="background:linear-gradient(160deg,${b.c1},${b.c2})">${buildPrettyCard(card,false)}</div>
   <div class="card-detail-data">
    <h3>${card.corp}</h3>
    <span class="detail-pill">${b.icon} ${b.name}</span>
    <span class="detail-pill">${card.type}</span>
    <span class="invest-profile">📊 ${investmentProfile(card).label}</span>
    <p><b>Kaufpreis:</b> ${card.cost||0} Zillionen</p>
    <p><b>Profil:</b> ${investmentProfile(card).text}</p>
    <p><b>Ausschüttung:</b> ${income}</p>
    <p><b>Branchenbonus:</b> Die Karte zählt für die Anzahl deiner Karten dieser Branche.</p>
    ${cert?`<p>📜 Die Aktienurkunde wird nach ihrer Ausschüttung aus deinem Depot entfernt.</p>`:""}
   </div>
  </div>`;
 modal("Karten-Details",body);
}
function renderDepot(){
 const p=state.players[state.viewedPlayer];
 q("depotTitle").textContent = `Sichtbar: ${p.name}`;
 const box=q("depot"); box.innerHTML="";
 const groups = {};
 sortCards(p.cards).forEach(card=>{
   if(!groups[card.branch]) groups[card.branch]=[];
   groups[card.branch].push(card);
 });
 const branchesWithCards = branchOrder.filter(id=>groups[id]?.length);
 if(!branchesWithCards.length){
   box.innerHTML=`<div class="depot-empty">Keine Karten vorhanden.</div>`;
   return;
 }
 branchesWithCards.forEach(id=>{
   const b=branchObj(id);
   const cards=groups[id];
   const step=26;
   const minWidth=108 + Math.max(0, cards.length-1)*step + 8;
   const fanCards=cards.map((card,i)=>{
     const rot = (-6 + i*3.1).toFixed(2)+"deg";
     const rise = (Math.abs((cards.length-1)/2 - i)*2.5).toFixed(1)+"px";
     return `<div class="depot-fan-card" style="left:${i*step}px; --rot:${rot}; --rise:${rise}; background:linear-gradient(160deg,${b.c1},${b.c2})">${buildPrettyCard(card,true)}</div>`;
   }).join("");
   const wrapper=document.createElement("div");
   wrapper.className="depot-group";
   wrapper.innerHTML=`<div class="depot-group-head"><span>${b.icon} ${b.name}</span><span>${cards.length} Karte${cards.length>1?'n':''}</span></div>
   <div class="depot-fan-wrap"><div class="depot-fan" style="width:${minWidth}px">${fanCards}</div></div>`;
   box.appendChild(wrapper);
 });
}

function selectMarketCard(id){
 if(state.phase!=="invest"||state.bought||state.locked)return;
 const card=state.market.find(c=>c.id===id),p=state.players[state.current];
 if(!card||p.cash<card.cost)return;
 state.selectedMarket=(state.selectedMarket===id?null:id);
 tone(state.selectedMarket?560:320,.05,"sine",.018);
 renderMarket();renderControls();
 if(state.selectedMarket)q("result").innerHTML=`Ausgewählt: <b>${card.corp}</b> · ${card.cost} Z → ${card.value} Z ${card.type==="Aktienurkunde"?"einmalig":"je Branchentreffer"}. Unten auf <b>Kaufen</b> tippen.`;
 else q("result").textContent="Keine Karte ausgewählt. Du kannst den Zug auch ohne Kauf beenden.";
}
function renderMarket(){
 const box=q("boardMarket");
 box.innerHTML="";
 state.market.forEach((card,idx)=>{
   const slot=document.createElement("div");
   slot.className="market-slot";
   const p=state.players[state.current];
   const can=state.phase==="invest"&&!state.bought&&!state.locked&&p.cash>=card.cost;
   const selected=state.selectedMarket===card.id;
   const cert=card.type==="Aktienurkunde";
   const d=document.createElement("div");
   d.className="invest-card "+(cert?"certificate ":"")+(can?"buyable":"disabled")+(selected?" market-selected":"")+(state.phase!=="invest"?" lock-look":"");
   d.innerHTML=buildPrettyCard(card,false);
   if(can)d.onclick=()=>selectMarketCard(card.id);

   const tag=document.createElement("div");
   tag.className="market-status"+(selected?" select-status":"");
   if(selected) tag.textContent="✓ ausgewählt";
   else if(state.phase!=="invest") tag.textContent="🔒";
   else if(state.bought) tag.textContent="✓";
   else if(p.cash<card.cost) tag.textContent="💰";
   else tag.textContent="";
   if(tag.textContent)slot.appendChild(tag);

   slot.appendChild(d);
   box.appendChild(slot);
 });
}

}

function renderControls(){
 const roll=q("rollBtn"),end=q("endBtn"),meta=q("diceMeta"),release=q("releaseBtn");
 updatePhaseStepper();
 if(state.gameEnded){roll.disabled=end.disabled=release.disabled=true;return}
 if(state.phase==="roll"){
   const heldCount=state.held.filter(Boolean).length;
   meta.textContent=state.rolls===0?"1. Wurf: Branche wird sofort gewertet":`Wurf ${state.rolls}/3 · ${heldCount} Würfel gehalten`;
   release.disabled=state.rolls===0||state.rolls>=3||state.locked||heldCount===0;
   roll.disabled=state.rolls>=3||state.locked;
   roll.textContent=state.rolls===0?"🎲 Würfeln":state.rolls<3?`🎲 Nochmal (${3-state.rolls})`:"Fertig";
   end.disabled=state.rolls===0||state.locked;
   end.textContent=state.rolls===0?"➡ Weiter":"💰 Ergebnis";
 }else{
   release.disabled=true;
   const chosen=state.market.find(c=>c.id===state.selectedMarket);
   if(state.bought){
     meta.textContent="Investment gekauft · Zug beenden";
     roll.disabled=true;roll.textContent="✓ Gekauft";
   }else if(chosen){
     meta.textContent=`${chosen.corp} ausgewählt`;
     roll.disabled=state.locked;roll.textContent=`🛒 Kaufen ${chosen.cost} Z`;
   }else{
     meta.textContent="Marktkarte antippen oder Zug ohne Kauf beenden";
     roll.disabled=true;roll.textContent="🛒 Karte wählen";
   }
   end.disabled=state.locked;end.textContent="➡ Zug beenden";
 }
}

function updatePhaseStepper(){
 const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll(".phase-step")];
 steps.forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("active","done"));
 const branch=steps.find(s=>s.dataset.phase==="branch");
 const dice=steps.find(s=>s.dataset.phase==="dice");
 const invest=steps.find(s=>s.dataset.phase==="invest");
 if(state.rolls===0&&state.phase==="roll"){branch?.classList.add("active")}
 else if(state.phase==="roll"){
   branch?.classList.add("done");dice?.classList.add("active");
 }else{
   branch?.classList.add("done");dice?.classList.add("done");invest?.classList.add("active");
 }
}

function rollDice(){
 if(state.phase!=="roll"||state.rolls>=3||state.locked)return;
 state.locked=true;
 const cup=q("diceCup"); if(cup)cup.classList.add("shaking");
 soundDice();
 renderControls(); renderDice();
 let ticks=0;
 const timer=setInterval(()=>{
   state.dice=state.dice.map((v,i)=>state.held[i]?v:1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6));
   if(state.rolls===0){const k=Math.floor(Math.random()*6); state.branchRoll=k===5?"news":branches[k].id;}
   renderDice();
   if(++ticks>=7){clearInterval(timer); finishRoll();}
 },65);
}
function finishRoll(){
 if(state.rolls===0){const k=Math.floor(Math.random()*6); state.branchRoll=k===5?"news":branches[k].id;}
 state.dice=state.dice.map((v,i)=>state.held[i]?v:1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6));
 state.rolls++; state.locked=false;
 const cup=q("diceCup"); if(cup)cup.classList.remove("shaking");
 renderDice();
 if(state.rolls===1) resolveBranch();
 const best=evaluate(state.dice);
 q("result").innerHTML=`Wurf ${state.rolls}/3 · <b>${best.name}</b>${best.value?` = ${best.value} Z`:""}`;
 if(state.rolls>=3&&!state.gameEnded)setTimeout(()=>settleDice(),350);
 render();
}

function branchBonus(normalShareCount){return normalShareCount<2?0:Math.min(12,(normalShareCount-1)*4)}

function animateMoneyTransfer(player, amount, incoming=true){
 try{
   const bank=q("bankDisplay")?.getBoundingClientRect();
   const playerIdx=state.players.indexOf(player);
   const playerEl=q("players")?.children?.[playerIdx];
   const pbox=playerEl?.getBoundingClientRect();
   if(!bank||!pbox)return;
   const note=document.createElement("div");
   note.className=`banknote-fly ${incoming ? "money-in" : "money-out"}`;
   note.textContent=`${incoming ? "+" : "-"}${amount} Z`;
   const start = incoming ? bank : pbox;
   const end = incoming ? pbox : bank;
   note.style.left=(start.left + start.width/2 - 24)+"px";
   note.style.top=(start.top + start.height/2 - 14)+"px";
   document.body.appendChild(note);
   requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
     note.style.transform=`translate(${end.left-start.left + (end.width-start.width)/2}px, ${end.top-start.top + (end.height-start.height)/2}px) scale(${incoming ? 0.92 : 1.06})`;
     note.style.opacity=".12";
   });
   setTimeout(()=>note.remove(),760);
 }catch(e){}
}
function activateFinalRound(){
 if(state.finalRound||state.gameEnded)return;
 state.finalRound=true;
 state.lastBankStage="final";
 log(`🏁 <b>Schlussrunde!</b> Diese Runde wird noch vollständig beendet.`);
 const old=document.querySelector(".final-round-toast");if(old)old.remove();
 const el=document.createElement("div");el.className="final-round-toast";
 el.innerHTML=`🏁 <b>Schlussrunde!</b><br>Jeder erhält in dieser Runde gleich viele Züge.<br><span class="final-bank-guarantee">Bankauszahlungen sind bis Rundenende garantiert</span>`;
 document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),3600);
 tone(620,.12,"triangle",.028);setTimeout(()=>tone(820,.18,"triangle",.026),130);
 saveGame(false);
}
function payFromBank(player,amount,label,source="other"){
 if(amount<=0||state.gameEnded)return 0;

 if(!state.finalRound && state.bank-amount<=finalThreshold()){
   activateFinalRound();
 }

 const paid=state.finalRound ? amount : Math.min(state.bank,amount);
 state.bank=Math.max(0,state.bank-paid);
 player.cash+=paid;

 if(source==="dice")player.stats.diceIncome+=paid;
 if(source==="branch")player.stats.branchIncome+=paid;

 if(paid>0){
   log(`💵 ${player.name} erhält <b>${paid} Z</b> ${label}${state.finalRound&&state.bank===0?" (Schlussrunden-Garantie)":""}.`);
   toast(`+${paid} Z`);soundCash();animateMoneyTransfer(player,paid,true);
   const idx=state.players.indexOf(player);
   setTimeout(()=>{const cards=q("players")?.children;if(cards&&cards[idx]){cards[idx].classList.add("cash-flash");setTimeout(()=>cards[idx].classList.remove("cash-flash"),720)}},20);
 }
 if(paid<amount)log(`🏦 Die Bank konnte nur noch ${paid} von ${amount} Z auszahlen.`);
 return paid;
}
function charge(player,amount,label,source="news"){
 if(amount<=0)return 0;
 const paid=Math.min(player.cash,amount);
 player.cash-=paid; state.bank+=paid;
 if(source==="news")player.stats.newsLoss+=paid;
 if(paid>0){log(`💸 ${player.name} zahlt <b>${paid} Z</b> (${label}).`); toast(`-${paid} Z`,false); animateMoneyTransfer(player, paid, false)}
 if(paid<amount)log(`⚠️ ${player.name} konnte die restlichen ${amount-paid} Z nicht bezahlen.`);
 return paid;
}

function showBranchBanner(branch,rows){
 const banner=q("branchBanner");
 q("branchBannerIcon").textContent=branch.icon;
 q("branchBannerTitle").textContent=`${branch.name} zahlt aus!`;
 q("branchBannerRows").innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(r=>`
   <div class="branch-banner-row">
    <span><b>${r.name}</b><span class="branch-breakdown">Aktien ${r.base} Z${r.certPay?` · Urkunden ${r.certPay} Z`:""}${r.bonus?` · Branchenbonus ${r.bonus} Z`:""}</span></span>
    <span class="plus">+${r.total} Z</span>
   </div>
 `).join(""):`<div class="branch-banner-row"><span>Niemand ist in dieser Branche investiert.</span><span>–</span></div>`;
 banner.classList.remove("hidden");
 setTimeout(()=>banner.classList.add("hidden"),2400);
}
function resolveBranch(){
 if(state.branchResolved||state.gameEnded)return;
 state.branchResolved=true;
 if(state.branchRoll==="news"){resolveNews(); return}
 const b=branchObj(state.branchRoll);
 log(`${b.icon} Branchenwürfel: <b>${b.name}</b>.`);
 const order=[]; for(let n=0;n<state.players.length;n++) order.push((state.current+n)%state.players.length);
 const summary=[];
 for(const idx of order){
   if(state.bank<=0&&!state.finalRound)break;
   const p=state.players[idx];
   const matching=p.cards.filter(c=>c.branch===b.id);
   if(!matching.length)continue;
   const regular=matching.filter(c=>c.type!=="Aktienurkunde");
   const normalShares=matching.filter(c=>c.type==="Aktie");
   const certs=matching.filter(c=>c.type==="Aktienurkunde");
   const base=regular.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.value,0);
   const certPay=certs.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.value,0);
   const bonus=branchBonus(normalShares.length);
   const total=base+certPay+bonus;
   const paid=payFromBank(p,total,`aus ${b.name}${bonus?` inkl. ${bonus} Z Branchenbonus`:""}`,"branch");
   summary.push({name:p.name,total:paid,bonus,base,certPay,cards:matching.length,normalShares:normalShares.length});
   if(certs.length){
     const certIds=new Set(certs.map(c=>c.id));
     p.cards=p.cards.filter(c=>!certIds.has(c.id));
     state.discard.push(...certs);
     log(`📜 ${p.name}: ${certs.length} Aktienurkunde${certs.length>1?"n":""} eingelöst und abgelegt.`);
   }
 }
 showBranchBanner(b,summary);
}

function evaluate(dice){
 const counts={}; dice.forEach(x=>counts[x]=(counts[x]||0)+1);
 const vals=Object.values(counts).sort((a,b)=>b-a);
 const uniq=[...new Set(dice)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
 const large=(uniq.join(",")==="1,2,3,4,5"||uniq.join(",")==="2,3,4,5,6");
 let small=false; for(let i=0;i<=uniq.length-4;i++) if(uniq[i+3]-uniq[i]===3) small=true;
 if(vals[0]===5)return{name:"5 Gleiche",value:30};
 if(large)return{name:"Große Straße",value:25};
 if(vals[0]===4)return{name:"4 Gleiche",value:20};
 if(vals[0]===3&&vals[1]===2)return{name:"Full House",value:15};
 if(small)return{name:"Kleine Straße",value:12};
 if(vals[0]===3)return{name:"3 Gleiche",value:9};
 if(vals.filter(x=>x>=2).length>=2)return{name:"2 Paare",value:7};
 if(vals[0]>=2)return{name:"1 Paar",value:5};
 return{name:"Kein zahlbares Ergebnis",value:0};
}
function settleDice(){
 if(state.phase!=="roll"||state.rolls===0||state.locked||state.gameEnded)return;
 const r=evaluate(state.dice), p=state.players[state.current];
 if(r.value){
   payFromBank(p,r.value,`für ${r.name}`,"dice");
   if(r.value>p.stats.bestValue){p.stats.bestValue=r.value;p.stats.bestResult=r.name}
 } else log(`▫️ ${p.name}: kein Würfelbonus.`);
 if(state.gameEnded)return;
 state.phase="invest";
 q("result").innerHTML=`<b>${r.name}</b> · Wähle jetzt unten auf dem Brett höchstens 1 Marktkarte.`;
 render();
}

}

function buySelectedMarketCard(){
 if(state.phase!=="invest"||!state.selectedMarket||state.bought||state.locked)return;
 const idx=state.market.findIndex(c=>c.id===state.selectedMarket);
 if(idx<0)return;
 const source=[...document.querySelectorAll("#boardMarket .invest-card")][idx];
 buyCard(idx,source);
}
function buyCard(idx,sourceEl){
 if(state.phase!=="invest"||state.bought||state.locked||state.gameEnded)return;
 const p=state.players[state.current], card=state.market[idx];
 if(!card||p.cash<card.cost)return;
 animatePurchase(card,sourceEl); soundBuy();
 p.cash-=card.cost; state.bank+=card.cost; p.cards.push(card); p.stats.spent+=card.cost; p.stats.purchases++;
 state.market.splice(idx,1); state.bought=true; state.selectedMarket=null; drawMarket();
 const b=branchObj(card.branch);
 log(`🛒 ${p.name} kauft <b>${card.corp}</b> (${card.type}, ${b.name}) für ${card.cost} Z.`);
 toast(`-${card.cost} Z`,false);
 state.viewedPlayer=state.current;
 setTimeout(()=>{const dep=q("depot")?.closest(".depot-panel");if(dep){dep.classList.add("flash");setTimeout(()=>dep.classList.remove("flash"),760)}},560);
 q("result").textContent=card.type==="Aktienurkunde"
   ? `Aktienurkunde gekauft: Bei ${b.name} wird sie automatisch für ${card.value} Z eingelöst.`
   : "Karte gekauft. Zug jetzt beenden.";
 render();
}
function nextTurn(){
 if(state.gameEnded)return;

 const next=(state.current+1)%state.players.length;

 if(state.finalRound && next===state.roundAnchor){
   endGame();
   return;
 }

 state.current=next;
 state.viewedPlayer=state.current;
 state.turnNumber++;
 state.players[state.current].stats.turns++;
 resetTurnState();

 const tr=q("turnTransition"),tn=q("turnTransitionName");
 if(tn)tn.textContent=state.players[state.current].name;
 if(tr){tr.classList.add("show");setTimeout(()=>tr.classList.remove("show"),850)}
 soundTurn();
 setLeftTab("score");
 q("result").textContent=state.finalRound?"Schlussrunde: letzter Zug für diesen Spieler.":"Bereit zum ersten Wurf.";
 log(`➡️ <b>${state.players[state.current].name}</b> ist am Zug${state.finalRound?" · Schlussrunde":""}.`);
 render();
}
function endGame(){
 if(state.gameEnded)return;
 state.gameEnded=true;
 clearSavedGame();
 soundCash(); setTimeout(()=>soundCash(),90); setTimeout(()=>tone(840,.18,"triangle",.03),180);
 const sorted=[...state.players].sort((a,b)=>b.cash-a.cash);
 const best=sorted[0].cash, winners=sorted.filter(p=>p.cash===best).map(p=>p.name).join(" & ");
 const medals=["🥇","🥈","🥉","4.","5."];
 const rows=sorted.map((p,i)=>`
   <div class="victory-row">
     <div class="victory-rank">${medals[i]||i+1}</div>
     <div>
       <div class="victory-player">${p.name}</div>
       <div class="victory-stats">🎲 ${p.stats.diceIncome} Z · 🏢 ${p.stats.branchIncome} Z · 🛒 ${p.stats.purchases} Käufe · Best: ${p.stats.bestResult}</div>
     </div>
     <div class="victory-money">${p.cash} Z</div>
   </div>`).join("");
 const body = `
   <div class="victory-burst"></div>
   <div class="trophy-wrap"><div class="trophy">🏆</div></div>
   <div class="victory-title">Spielende</div>
   <div class="victory-sub">Die Schlussrunde ist beendet · Gewertet wird nur Bargeld</div>
   <div class="victory-winner">
     <div class="name">${winners}</div>
     <div class="cash">gewinnt mit ${best} Zillionen</div>
   </div>
   <div class="victory-ranking">${rows}</div>`;
 modal("🏆 Spielende", body, "victory-mode");
 q("modalOk").textContent="Neu starten";
 q("modalOk").onclick=()=>location.reload();
 render();
}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
 if(e.key==="Escape"&&document.body.classList.contains("board-focus")){
   document.body.classList.remove("board-focus");q("focusBtn").textContent="▣";
 }
});
document.addEventListener("dblclick",e=>e.preventDefault(),{passive:false});
</script>
